config.description: Compact Qwen3-32B v0.9 acceptance: three ABBA cases and 12 independent benchmark processes. Use v09_ascend_a3_full.json only for optional exhaustive follow-up.

prompts: 用一句话解释 KV Cache。
说明 Prefill 和 Decode 的区别。
请沿着请求进入调度器、完成 Prefill、逐 token Decode、释放 KV Cache 的顺序，解释每一步的数据形状、状态变化和可能失败的位置。

command: 4 physical cards, 2 logical devices per card

distributed.legacy_memory_scope: last measured run, before optional profile; CPU zero is a compatibility sentinel

measurement_scope.prefill: Prefill 开始到首 token 在 device 上计算完成，包含 token 选择
measurement_scope.ttft: 请求开始到第一个 token 取回并 decode 为文本
measurement_scope.tpot: 除第一个 token 外，后续 token 计算、取回并 decode 为文本的平均同步间隔
measurement_scope.e2e_latency: 请求开始到完整 token 序列 decode 为文本

host_operator_time.semantics: operator self duration from the explicitly named CSV column
host_operator_time.reason: the legacy parser selected Device Self Duration

phase_device_time.semantics: must not infer device phase attribution from host markers alone

measurement_scope.arrival: all rows arrive at batch start, before shared tokenization
measurement_scope.ttft: batch start to this row's first token decoded for delivery
measurement_scope.tpot: mean interval between this row's delivered tokens, excluding its first token
measurement_scope.request_e2e: batch start to this row's terminal completion/full-text detokenization; finished rows do not wait for remaining rows
measurement_scope.e2e_latency: whole-batch wall time, retained separately from per-request E2E
measurement_scope.profiling: a separate output-equivalent replay excluded from measured runs
